correctness.rationale: The 15-dimensional coefficient space has 32,767 nonzero masks and no nontrivial scalar equivalence. On each of the seven lines, a binary quartic is squarefree iff its one-variable dehomogenization has degree at least three (no multiple root at infinity) and gcd one with its derivative. In coefficients a,b,c,d,e from U^4 to V^4, the derivative at V=1 is bU^2+d, recovering the three stated cases, including checking a at infinity when b=0. Fresh exact substitution found 2,559 transverse-free masks, with 25 surviving the necessary Jacobian test at rational points. All 75 affine-chart ideals (F, F_X, F_Y, F_Z) on these 25 have Gröbner basis {1}, establishing geometric smoothness over the algebraic closure. Fresh substitution by the 168 invertible matrices identifies orbits of masks 6438 and 20181, with sizes 24 and 1, point counts 7 and 0, and stabilizers 7 and 168. All seven restrictions of 20181 equal the square of U^2+UV+V^2, the unique monic irreducible binary quadratic with no rational root in rational basis coordinates, so the property holds in every rational basis. Every line in the filling case has three rational intersection points and its residual divisor of degree one is rational, hence repeats one of them. Smooth plane quartic genus is three. The warning that pointlessness alone does not suffice also holds: the sum of the six square monomials X^4,Y^4,Z^4,X^2Y^2,Y^2Z^2,Z^2X^2, plus X^3Y+XY^3+X^2YZ, is 1 at every rational point. Its common gradient zeros can only be (0:0:1) and (1:0:1), neither on it, and the line Z=0 has squarefree restriction with all five coefficients one.
